overall_description: A two-player upright arcade machine with a wide control panel, twin joystick positions, and a lower cashbox door beneath the screen, plus a small payout tray flap near the lower front. the lower cabinet remains tall and boxy enough for a believable coin-op silhouette, and the tray flap reads as a supported door in the lower cabinet face. The cashbox door rotates on a vertical hinge at one side of the lower cabinet, and the payout tray flap rotates on a small lower hinge. Commercial arcade scale.
